rationale: Source is a design brainstorm for a NEW typed inter-agent protocol with an explicit 'Does NOT exist yet / VERIFY' list. Additive verbs throughout; no broken behaviour. The plan verifies each VERIFY claim against the codebase and locates the closest existing patterns to extend (A2A client/server, MCP client + transports, ToolManager, WorkingMemory toolkit, AgentRegistry, AuditLedger, PBAC, eventbus, observability, storage/artifacts) plus overlapping SDD documents (semantic-layer result handles / audit ledger / PBAC gate, structured-artifact contract, agent-host protocol).

queries.intent: Orient: locate the A2A client and server implementation (closest pattern for calling a remote agent).

params.question: A2A client remote agent call agent card

queries.intent: Orient: locate MCP client transports (stdio, HTTP, Unix socket, QUIC) to verify the transport inventory and absence of gRPC.

params.question: MCP client transport stdio http unix socket quic

queries.intent: Orient: ToolManager registration and toolkit lifecycle (verify no mount/unmount per category).

params.question: ToolManager register tool toolkit lifecycle cleanup

queries.intent: Orient: WorkingMemory toolkit — what it stores, keys, dataframe handling, previews.

params.question: working memory toolkit store result dataframe reference

queries.intent: Orient: AgentRegistry and how remote agents are registered with a kind (a2a).

params.question: AgentRegistry register remote agent kind a2a

queries.intent: Orient: the AuditLedger (signed, append-only) the brainstorm says already exists.
Orient: PBAC / policy enforcement at tool execution.
Orient: navigator-eventbus usage inside parrot (publish/subscribe, correlation).

params.question: event bus navigator eventbus publish subscribe

queries.intent: Orient: observability — OpenTelemetry spans, trace_id propagation, token usage / cost accounting.

params.question: observability opentelemetry trace span token usage cost

queries.intent: Orient: structured artifact contract / outputs artifacts / handles — overlap with the handle+descriptor data model.

params.question: structured artifact contract outputs handle descriptor
